summary: Park With Us quotes read: $25 (30 amp Site 1) / $35 (Sites 2-4) confirmed for Nov 2026 and Jun 2027, +8% online service fee; full hookups 30/50 amp confirmed; 4 back-in sites to 45 ft; wifi; booking on the operator's Park With Us engine, 27-night online max, no pets.
flags: PRIVATE GATES: cheapest real RV night $25 (Site 1, 30 amp, 45-ft limit) and $35 on the 30/50 amp sites, Nov 2026 and Jun 2027 alike; $37.80 with the 8% Park With Us service fee - well under US$50. No gateway within 40 km; family has not stayed. Not in the Good Sam directory. Presence: working site trailheadcnc.com with phone 515-979-6008 and a live booking engine.
REVIEWS: Google 5.0 / 37; RV Life 4.5 over 2. Nothing under 4.0 with 25+ reviews.

LONG-STAY: pass. All four RV sites sold by the night on the engine (1-night minimum, 27-night online maximum, longer by phone); no seasonal sites, homes or lots seen. Tests: 1 $25-35; 2 nightly sold online; 3 no minimum; 4 4 of 4 nightly; 5 an RV/cabin campground.
POLICY: no pets on any RV site ('pets': false on every site; rental agreement 'The Renters will bring no animals or pets of any kind onto the Premises'). Put in the note; report in case it matters.

SITES: the operator contradicts itself on the count - home page 'Four (4) full hook-up campsites (2 - 50 amp and 1- 30amp)' and /camping '3 FULL Hook Up Campsites 2 - 50 amp and 1- 30amp', while the /camping rate list and the engine both show four (Site 1 30 amp, Sites 2-4 30/50 amp). Engine marks Sites 1 and 4 not bookable online at present. Kept count 4.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored 'not waterfront'): the pond is ~0.3 acre (main lobe ~33 x 37 m plus a small NE lobe on imagery) - a pond. On the operator's site map Site 4's back-in pad faces the pond across open lawn with no road between, about a pond-width away; Site 1 is across the loop drive (blocked) and Sites 2-3 sit south of the loop among the cabins. I could not make out Site 4's pad on imagery to measure it, so 'not waterfront' stands unless AWH reads Site 4 as on the pond ('pond' would be the value; there is no pond-view).
PIN OK: stored 42.4041,-93.0805 is at the pond, within ~60 m of all four sites.
